svg.text: Orbit, top-down or cut open the same station to find hidden passages.
Orbit to place kit and passages.
Look down from above to check the layout.
Open the shell to see inside.
Pull floors apart to see vertical links.
Get close to passengers and see the space.
Drag the cube to orbit; the height bar switches floors.
Can't see it? Look from another angle.
